article.title: Meta-analysis of diagnostic validation studies on noninvasive methods for detecting Helicobacter pylori in the pediatric population.
article.authors: Montoya-Arango MA, Figueredo-Carmona EA, Zapata SY
article.abstract: Early detection and eradication of Helicobacter pylori in high-prevalence regions are effective for reducing the incidence of gastric cancer, but evidence supporting its detection in the pediatric population is less robust. Our aim was to evaluate the diagnostic validity of noninvasive methods for detecting Helicobacter pylori in pediatric patients based on studies published in the medical literature.
